notes.title: Demo v0.1.4 Is out!
notes.notes:
Patch notes for Demo v0.1.4:
- You can now choose Save File in the main menu. 
- Added intro to the start of the game.
- Teleporters are now functional.
- You can now buy a new weapon from merchant called "Needles".
- The inventory has been redesigned.
- Added alternative paintings.
- fixed some of the vegetation sprites that had missing shadows.

Thank you for playing,
Johnny
